title: What's Hiding Inside an Apple?
sources: Kids nutrition & healthy habits basics (USDA MyPlate kids, CDC handwashing, ADA toothbrushing guidance)

beats.say: Crunchy, round, and it grows on a tree. Do you know what's inside?
Hi! I'm Pip the strawberry, and this is Kiko! Welcome to Fruity Friends!
Apple! Apples grow on trees.
What's hiding inside an apple? Little seeds! They make a star shape.
Can you pretend to pick an apple from a tree? Reach up high!
Apples help keep your teeth and tummy happy. See you next time on Fruity Friends!

title: Why Do Carrots Grow Underground?
sources: Kids nutrition & healthy habits basics (USDA MyPlate kids, CDC handwashing, ADA toothbrushing guidance)

beats.say: This orange veggie plays hide and seek under the ground!
Hi! I'm Pip the strawberry, and this is Kiko! Welcome to Fruity Friends!
Carrot! Carrots grow down in the dirt.
Are carrots always orange? No! Some are purple, yellow or white.
Can you pull a carrot out of the ground? Pull, pull, POP!
Carrots help your eyes stay healthy. See you next time on Fruity Friends!

title: How Long Should You Wash Your Hands?
sources: Kids nutrition & healthy habits basics (USDA MyPlate kids, CDC handwashing, ADA toothbrushing guidance)

beats.say: Soap, water, and lots of bubbles. How long should we scrub?
Hi! I'm Pip the strawberry, and this is Kiko! Welcome to Fruity Friends!
Wash Hands! Wash your hands before you eat.
How long should we scrub? Twenty seconds! Like singing a song.
Rub your hands together with me! Scrub, scrub, scrub!
Clean hands keep germs away. See you next time on Fruity Friends!

title: How Long Should You Brush Your Teeth?
sources: Kids nutrition & healthy habits basics (USDA MyPlate kids, CDC handwashing, ADA toothbrushing guidance)

beats.say: Morning and night, round and round. How long do we brush?
Hi! I'm Pip the strawberry, and this is Kiko! Welcome to Fruity Friends!
Brush Teeth! Brush your teeth in the morning and at night.
How long should we brush? Two minutes! Ask a grown-up to help.
Can you pretend to brush? Round and round!
Brushing keeps your smile bright. See you next time on Fruity Friends!

title: Why Is Watermelon So Juicy?
sources: Kids nutrition & healthy habits basics (USDA MyPlate kids, CDC handwashing, ADA toothbrushing guidance)

beats.say: Green outside, pink inside, and super juicy. Why?
Hi! I'm Pip the strawberry, and this is Kiko! Welcome to Fruity Friends!
Watermelon! Watermelons are big and heavy.
What are the little black dots? Seeds! Watermelons have lots of them.
Can you take a big pretend bite? Chomp!
Watermelon is a cool treat on a hot day. See you next time on Fruity Friends!
